body: EARLY SECURITY LEAD: C-01 must be strengthened beyond separate PWA routes. Make Audience and Presenter distinct origins + distinct authenticated server topics/data contracts; the audience client must never receive transcript, prompts, RAG candidates, coaching, team messages, ACL metadata, or unpublished cards (not even hidden/encrypted client-side). Publication is a one-way server-side state transition producing a minimal immutable AudienceCard DTO. I am sourcing the full invariant set now.
